schema_version.description: Schema version for the Phase 2 greybox tunables file.

player.description: First-person movement and look tuning values for the greybox slice.

walk_speed_ms.description: Player walking speed in meters per second.

run_speed_ms.description: Player running speed in meters per second.

crouch_speed_ms.description: Player crouch speed in meters per second.

mouse_sensitivity.description: Mouse-look sensitivity multiplier for first-person camera control.

detection.description: Patroller vision, detection, and chase tuning values.

vision_half_angle_deg.description: Half-angle of the patroller vision cone in degrees.

vision_range_m.description: Maximum detection range in meters when line of sight is clear.

base_detect_time_s.description: Continuous time in seconds needed to detect the player at zero cash heat.

min_detect_time_s.description: Minimum continuous detection time floor after cash heat reduces the base time.

chase_speed_mult.description: Multiplier applied to player run speed when the patroller is chasing.

chase_break_los_s.description: Seconds of broken line of sight needed for the patroller to abandon the chase.

cash_heat.description: Cash-carry heat parameters that make walking home riskier over time.

carry_threshold.description: Minimum carried cash that starts building outdoor cash heat.

heat_per_hour_over_threshold.description: Cash heat gained per in-game hour while carrying above the threshold outdoors.

catch_stop.description: Catch-stop resolution values for bribe and flee outcomes.

bribe_cost.description: Cash cost of choosing the bribe option at a catch stop.

flee_escape_chance.description: Probability that the flee option succeeds, expressed as a decimal fraction.

economy.description: Greybox economy values for the visible debt ledger and the canned Gate-2 bet.

debt_start.description: Initial on-screen debt ledger amount for the greybox slice.

canned_bet_stake.description: Stake amount used for the deterministic canned Gate-2 bet.

canned_bet_payout.description: Winning payout amount returned by the canned Gate-2 bet.

canned_bet_seed.description: Fixed RNG seed used to make the canned Gate-2 bet deterministic.

canned_bet_home_team.description: Zero-based team index for the canned bet home team.

canned_bet_away_team.description: Zero-based team index for the canned bet away team.

clock.description: In-game clock values for advancing time and defining night hours.

minutes_per_game_hour.description: Real-time minutes required for one in-game hour to pass.

night_start_hour.description: Hour of day when night begins, using a 24-hour clock.

night_end_hour.description: Hour of day when night ends, using a 24-hour clock.
